summary: Learn CRO methods, A/B testing, and landing page optimisation to improve conversions and ROI. Enrol in TrainingCred’s 5-day course.
lede: Conversion rate optimisation uses measurable evidence to improve the share of visitors who complete a desired action. It is for professionals managing or influencing website traffic, landing pages, forms, checkout steps or lead-generation campaigns, and covers mapping journeys, identifying friction, forming hypotheses, planning A/B tests and tracking conversion KPIs. Learners also practise interpreting results and building a prioritised optimisation roadmap.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already manage or influence website traffic, landing pages, forms, checkout steps, or lead-generation campaigns and need stronger conversion evidence.
audience: Head of Digital or Marketing Director
prerequisites: Participants should have a working understanding of website performance, digital marketing funnels, and basic web metrics such as sessions, bounce rate, click-through rate, and conversion rate. Familiarity with Google Analytics 4, landing pages, or ecommerce or lead-generation reporting will help you move faster, but coding is not required. Advanced optimisation concepts are taught at an operational application level, with practical exercises using templates, dashboards, and test-planning tools.
